_note: #322, #336. R1 reads no header line over 1000 characters, and opens the reviewed path only when it is a regular file of the repository. good and at-limit (a Reviewed: line of exactly 1000 characters) have no finding. long-reviewed's Reviewed: line is 1001 characters and long-version's Version line: is: neither is read, and the finding names the line. long-supersedes's Supersedes: line is 1001 characters: it is reported, as a name R1 cannot read always was, and retires nothing. folder and folder-slash name a folder, and root names the repository itself with an empty quoted path: each is a finding, where R1 used to stop as broken. git-folder and git-folder-spelled name a path inside git's own folder; this fixture has no such folder, and the path alone is refused. A link, a path through a linked folder and the time one long line takes cannot be shipped as files: scripts/r1.test.mjs (slipway only) builds them. dir.md is a folder named like a review (#341): it is a finding, and nothing in it is read.
